blocks.text: Admins can create and manage users in your organization's Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform). Managing users includes defining their access and permissions by assigning Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), optionally assigning Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) permissions, and deactivating or deleting users.

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click the Profile menu in the top navigation bar, and click Account Settings.
See image.
In the left-side navigation, go to User Management.
See image.
On the User Management page, click Create.
See image.
The Create User page appears.
On the Create User page:
Email: Enter the user's organization email.
First Name: Enter the user's first name.
Last Name: Enter the user's last name.
Main Account: (Optional) If you have more than one account, set the user's default account.
Roles: Expand the section and select a role for the user. If you don't, the user is assigned the default No Access role. To learn more, see Understanding System Roles and Managing User Roles.
See image.
See image.
Click Save.
The new user details are displayed on the User Management page.

blocks.text: As an admin, you can manage users by adding and deleting users, assigning user roles, and applying content permissions.

blocks.item: To sort the users list in ascending or descending order, hover over the column header and click the arrow icon.
To filter the users list, hover over the column header and click the Filter icon. You can also create a Condition filter.
See image.

blocks.text: You can perform the following actions:

blocks.item: Assign User Roles and Content Permissions
Deactivate Users
Delete Users
